SQLite only. Supply WITH ratio_input AS (your SELECT exposing group_id, numerator, denominator), append these CTEs, and SELECT from ratio_result. Reserve ratio_* names. One output row per input row, including failures; no grouping, filtering or deduplication. Only exact integer quantities are supported, including REAL values that already equal integers. ratio_checked AS (
  SELECT group_id, numerator, denominator,
    CASE WHEN numerator IS NULL OR denominator IS NULL THEN 'null_input'
      WHEN typeof(numerator) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')

  FROM ratio_input
), ratio_result AS (
  SELECT group_id, numerator, denominator, status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN
      (CAST(numerator AS INTEGER) * 100) * 1.0 / CAST(denominator AS INTEGER)
    END AS ratio_value
  FROM ratio_checked
)
